WHERE
  { ?var1  wdt:P136  wde:Q8261 .
    ?var1 (wdt:P31)* wde:Q7725634 .
    ?var1  wdt:P50  ?var4
    OPTIONAL

PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT DISTINCT  ?var1
WHERE
  { ?var1  wdt:P580  ?var2 ;
           wdt:P582  ?var3
    FILTER ( ( ?var2 >= "1956-12-04T00:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime ) && ( ?var2 <= "1966-12-04T23:59:59Z"^^xsd:dateTime ) )
    FILTER ( ( ?var3 >= "1966-12-04T00:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime ) && ( ?var3 <= "1976-12-04T23:59:59Z"^^xsd:dateTime ) )
  }

PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX  wde:  <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?var1 (COUNT(DISTINCT ?var2) AS ?var3) ?var4
WHERE
  { BIND(if(EXISTS { ?var2  wdt:P50  wde:Q18631272 }, "string1", "string2") AS ?var4)
    BIND(str(year(?var5)) AS ?var1)
    ?var6  wdt:P50    wde:Q18631272 .
    ?var2  wdt:P2860  ?var6 ;
           wdt:P577   ?var5
  }
GROUP BY ?var1 ?var4
ORDER BY DESC(?var1)
